headline: Executive order creates a White House initiative to support and promote Historically Black Colleges and Universities.
what_it_does: This order sets up a White House initiative focused on Historically Black Colleges and Universities (HBCUs). Based on its title, the goal is to promote excellence and new ideas at these schools. No summary was provided, so the specific programs, funding, or duties it creates are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: The schools become the focus of a White House effort meant to support their quality and innovation.
They may be affected by any federal efforts the initiative directs toward their schools, though the details are not stated in the title.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed February 28, 2017; executive orders usually take effect when signed.
